items.title: Live: Telstra outage impacting trains, traffic lights and business payment services
items.description: Some Telstra customers are reporting problems connecting to the internet and making calls this morning. Follow live.

items.title: US launches new Iran strikes after tankers attacked in Strait of Hormuz
items.description: The US Central Command confirms strikes had been launched against Iran in retaliation for attacks on three tankers passing through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Critical drugs could be pulled from PBS amid pricing stoush
items.description: The latest PBS stoush with drugmakers means thousands of people with MS are at risk of being forced to pay $33,000 a year for lifesaving medication.

items.title: IS-linked Australian accused of abusing Yazidi girl enslaved in her home
items.description: The last of the known Islamic State-linked Australian women in Syria is expected to return home amid allegations a Yazidi girl was enslaved, beaten and raped in the woman's home a decade ago, the ABC can reveal.

items.title: The 'amazing' turnaround in literacy at this primary school
items.description: An inspiring turnaround at an Aboriginal community school could provide a scalable solution for closing the gap on Indigenous literacy.

items.title: The faces in the crowd at the Ayatollah's funeral
items.description: The strictly choreographed funeral of Iran's former supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has presented a rare insight into the image Tehran wants to project to the world and the men they see as central to it.

items.title: Farage quits as an MP but vows to win 'circus' by-election
items.description: Nigel Farage, the far-right political leader riding a surge of support in Britain, has announced a major gamble that could end his political career.

items.title: Parents of child abused by Sydney care worker want ban on male educators
items.description: The devastated parents of a child abused by disgraced childcare worker David James are calling for urgent reform to the out-of-school-hours care system to better protect children.

items.title: Live: Messi leads incredible Argentina comeback before Swiss shootout delight
items.description: Lionel Messi guides Argentina to an incredible comeback win against Egypt, coming back from 2-0 down to steal a 3-2 win at the death, while Switzerland knocks Colombia out in a penalty shootout. Follow live.

items.title: Live: PM prepares to host leaders of three Pacific nations in Brisbane
items.description: The prime minister will host the leaders of PNG, Tonga and Samoa in Brisbane today for regional security talks after signing of the Ocean of Peace Alliance with Fiji. Follow live.

items.title: China missile test hits a bullseye in the Pacific — but it's one they didn't want
items.description: This week, perhaps for the first time in a long time, some sections of the Pacific are signalling a slight adjustment to their relationship with China.

items.title: Netanyahu warns Trump against F-35 deal with Türkiye
items.description: The Israeli prime minister has appeared on American TV to urge the US president not to sell jet fighters to Türkiye, adding to a growing list of tensions between the leaders.

items.title: 'Teeth can heal': Oral health giant's ad claims called into question
items.description: Oral care giant Hismile has used "misleading" videos in social media advertisements showing a sales professional, and its own staff, spruiking products while dressed as health workers.

items.title: Marine Le Pen to enter French presidential race as court trims ban
items.description: The court in Paris upheld Marine Le Pen's conviction for misusing EU funds but shortened her ban on running for elected office.

items.title: Five podcasts we're listening to this NAIDOC Week
items.description: Some of our favourite Indigenous-led podcasts this week and every week include interviews with AFL greats, a dive into Aboriginal astronomy, and conversations with a renowned artist who loves Dolly Parton.

items.title: Quiz: Jump in, we're going on a trip around the world
items.description: Which Mediterranean island was a setting for The Godfather? And what's the capital city of Morocco?

items.title: What time is the State of Origin Game III decider tonight?
items.description: The men's State of Origin series will be decided tonight, as Queensland hosts New South Wales at Lang Park in a winner-takes-all Game III. Here is what you need to know ahead of kick-off.

items.title: Prince Harry loses privacy case against Daily Mail, calls ruling 'whitewash'
items.description: Prince Harry and six other claimants, including singer Elton John, have lost their claims against Daily Mail's publisher after alleging their phones were tapped, voicemails intercepted and personal information obtained through deception.

items.title: Government report says AI not causing mass job lay-offs, yet
items.description: Artificial intelligence is not yet causing a broad disruption to Australia's labour market, according to a government report.

items.title: Toddler waits seven hours for stitches during patient surge
items.description: A Central Victorian mother says she waited seven hours at Bendigo Health for her toddler to be treated for a head wound.

items.title: Teammates of Melbourne footballer will sit next match out after death
items.description: Epping football club's reserves players have decided to skip this weekend's game following the death of their beloved teammate Nathan Fitzgerald on Monday night.

items.title: Housing inequity in Australia 'must focus beyond age'
items.description: The federal government must look at age and wealth together to meaningfully deal with the growing wealth divide between generations, according to The Australian Council of Social Services (ACOSS).

items.title: Djokovic wins five-hour Wimbledon epic to set up Sinner blockbuster
items.description: Tennis legend Novak Djokovic sets up a Wimbledon semifinal blockbuster against Jannik Sinner after a five-hour epic.

items.title: 'I'm getting old': 28yo Osaka's Wimbledon run ends at quarterfinals
items.description: Japan's Naomi Osaka bemoans getting old as her inspiring Wimbledon run comes to an end in the quarterfinals.

items.title: Russia could compete at 2028 Olympics after suspension provisionally lifted
items.description: The International Olympic Committee has not yet decided whether Russia can display its flag and colours or have its anthem played at the Games.
